Latin word

certus

certus, certa, certum

certain, particular (people, days); particular, fixed, specified; sure, certain

In this lexicon

  • certain

    also used · classical · Cic. Brut. 64: habet certōs suī studiōsōs (Lewis & Short)

  • particular

    the recommended word · classical · Ov. Rem. 189: temporibus certīs; Varr. RR 2.1.19: certō tempore

  • sure

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ad. 329: Satin' hoc certum est? — Certum.; Cic. Att. 2.19.5: certī sumus perīsse omnia; Traupman 108, 388

  • certus cursus: route

    modern
